integrity: A self-contained analytic argument and a standalone finite exact checker are included. The novel claim is joint independence; known marginal distributions and tree bijections are explicitly credited. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
limitations: Uniform type-A noncrossing partitions only; fixed finite shifts; lattice subsequences; no rates or infinite-dimensional topology; relevant wider general random-allocation work may provide implicit equivalences.
title: Joint Poisson–Gaussian independence for extreme blocks of a uniform noncrossing partition
